subject: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Team —

As we prep the QBR next week, leadership wants a tight summary of where we stand on the product/engineering roadmap items targeted for Q2 launches and the top delivery risks that could affect our revenue/commitments. Please help with the following by end of day Thursday (Mar 12):

1) One-page status per OKR launch (status, committed ship date, delta from plan)
2) Top 3 delivery risks per launch, with: likelihood, impact, and mitigation plan
3) Any required leadership decisions (e.g., capacity commit, rollback thresholds, third-party dependencies)
4) Short note on customer/partner communications if we slip beyond the committed week

I've attached a slide outline to drop the one-pagers into (Q2_QBR_prep_slide_outline.pdf). Keep language short — leadership wants concrete asks and one-slide evidence.

Quick context: execs will press on Model Serving GA (feature flag launch), Redwood Dedicated capacity bump for TeamBlue, and the streaming SDK roll for hosted API customers. We need clear timelines and cost delta if we trigger extra GPU reservations.

I'll collect inputs and produce a consolidated QBR slide for review Friday morning. Ping me if you need extra data from Finance or Sales.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Marissa —

Thanks, I'll own the product-side one-pagers. High-level notes for the three items called out:

- Model Serving GA (feature-flag rollout)
  - Status: Beta completed w/ 6 customers; internal canary scheduled next week
  - Committed ship date: 2026-04-15 (current) — risk: infra dependency for KV cache invalidation may push ~2 weeks
  - Decision needed: Approve temporary canary on dedicated infra or delay public GA by 2 weeks

- Redwood Dedicated capacity bump (TeamBlue contract)
  - Status: Procurement done; infra provisioning blocked by capacity reservation window with partner
  - Committed ship date: 2026-04-01 — risk: vendor-side GPU availability ~1 week variability
  - Ask: Ops to confirm soft-reserve by Mar 16 to hold timeline

- Streaming SDK roll (hosted)
  - Status: SDK PRs merged; end-to-end tests failing intermittently (telemetry client)
  - Committed ship date: 2026-03-29 — risk: telemetry dependency may cause rollback weeks

I've exported a trimmed OKR status CSV (okrs_status_export.csv) with current percent complete and blocked flags — drop it into the slide where helpful. Also linking the spec in Drive for the GA plan: https://drive.google.com/open?id=serving-ga-spec.

I'll add mitigation text and suggested leadership asks in the one-pagers.

—Karthik
Product Director, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Marissa / Karthik —

Engineering takeaways and risk breakdown (short):

1) KV cache invalidation (Model Serving GA)
   - Why: current implementation requires a global coordination step that blocks parallel rollout across region clusters
   - Likelihood: high if we keep the current coord window
   - Impact: potential 2–3 week delay to GA; might require rolling restarts during canary
   - Mitigation: implement an optimistic invalidation path (2-week engineering effort) OR run GA on dedicated infra (ops support)

2) Vendor telemetry client (Streaming SDK)
   - Why: intermittent serialization bug in telemetry lib v2.1 (third-party)
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: flapping E2E tests; customer-facing instability if rolled early
   - Mitigation: pin older telemetry client + vendor hotfix (coord with cloudops@stratapartner.com). Work estimate: 3–5 days + vendor schedule uncertainty

3) Dedicated capacity scheduling (TeamBlue)
   - Why: partner booking window mismatch and GPU SKU availability differences between regions
   - Likelihood: medium
   - Impact: 1-week to 3-week slip depending on SKU substitution tolerance
   - Mitigation: request soft-reserve and adjust fallback plan to smaller clusters (cost impact documented)

I attached a short rationale note (infra_risk_rationale.txt) with the technical tradeoffs and earliest remediation estimates. Also: we need a decision on whether to accept a temporary performance delta for GA in exchange for keeping the April date.

Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Thanks for the quick inputs. Two asks from me:

1) Escalate KV cache coord dependency now — if the optimistic invalidation path is the only way to keep GA, we need a resource commitment (1.5 FTE for 2 weeks) or approve the dedicated infra canary. Please summarize cost and timeline tradeoffs in the slide next to the risk.

2) For TeamBlue capacity, provide expected cost delta for the SKU fallback option and communications plan if we must delay beyond the committed week. Sales will need a short customer note and an updated delivery SLA. Markus, can you prep a short customer-facing blurb we can repurpose?

Also propose a 30-minute sync to go over slide drafts Wednesday (Mar 11) at 4:00 PM PT. If that doesn't work, suggest alternatives.

- Laura
VP, Product & GTM Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Laura / Marissa —

I can draft the TeamBlue customer note and the SLA amendment. Quick notes:
- If we need a SKU fallback, we should offer TeamBlue a one-week credit if the delay exceeds the committed window.
- I'll loop in our partner contact at Stratapartner (cloudops@stratapartner.com) to confirm soft-reserve pricing and lead time.

I'll circulate a short blurb by EOD today. If we need to escalate to legal for contract language, flag it and I'll start the intake.

-Markus
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Launch timelines & delivery risks — inputs needed

Appreciate the fast responses. Quick plan of record:

- Karthik & Connor: please upload finalized one-pagers to the Drive outline (https://drive.google.com/open?id=QBR2026_slides_outline) by EOD today (Mar 12). Put the cost/tradeoff table next to the KV cache risk and call out the exact ask (FT allocation or infra canary).
- Markus: please send the TeamBlue customer note and the soft-reserve confirmation from Stratapartner; include the cost delta if SKU fallback used.
- Laura: we will brief you with the consolidated slides Fri morning; confirm if you want the 4:00 PM sync today — I'll host if teams can make it.

Attached: Q2_QBR_prep_slide_outline.pdf (skeleton) — drop one-pagers into the named slides. If any item is blocked beyond EOD, call it out explicitly in the slide as "Decision required: <what>".

Thanks — looking forward to clean one-slide asks.

Marissa
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
